title: rec memo
description: {base}.memo.v1.json beside the recording's parts: the user's own memo about one recording, typed while it records or any time after. Every change also goes to the recording's Drive or iCloud folder as {base}.memo.json, the same JSON, with the folder's memoAt; a local folder keeps it on the device. An emptied memo stays as an empty text, so the change reaches the other devices. See docs/recly.md §8 "Memo" and §3 "Drive layout".

text.description: As the user typed it, line breaks kept, at most 2000 characters. Empty when the user emptied it.

updatedAt.description: When the user last changed it; the newer copy wins, and the folder's memoAt is this value.
